abstract: LLM Inference Engine for Metal, CUDA and Vulkan.https://tensorfold.devTensorFold TensorFold serves language models from a Zig binary on Apple Silicon and NVIDIA GPUs. The engine reads checkpoints, tokenizes requests and runs Metal or CUDA kernels directly. Serving needs no Python or MLX installation. Building with a coding agent? Have it load the contributor skill before it writes any code. Contributing with agents Please use Agent Traffic Control before editing TensorFold so contributors and agents can avoid duplicate work and conflicting changes. Check the live agent radar before choosing an issue and follow CONTRIBUTING.md and the ATC contributor instructions. Install or upgrade ATC to 0.9.4 or later, then run from an updated TensorFold clone: npm install -g github:ashhart/ATC atc check ISSUE --json atc claim ISSUE --json Replace ISSUE with the issue number and claim only after a complete check says the work is free. TensorFold enables automatic public check-ins: a successful new claim starts an anonymous session on the radar and returns its session number. Keep that number instead of starting a duplicate session. For work already yours, start a session with atc start ISSUE --json.
